text:
Ava (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on pricing/quotas: several product teams asked how free credits, reserved capacity, and transient burst allowances interact during launches. Can we summarize the rules and who to contact? :confused:

Samir (VP Product): Short answer: three separate levers. 1) Promotional credits reduce invoice balance but do not expand rate limits. 2) Reserved capacity customers have higher hard quotas and SLA-protected throughput. 3) We offer a short-lived burst buffer on top of the per-account QPS for small spikes. For large launch support we do manual temp increases.

Jamie (Finance): To add: credits are monetary only. They don't change quota metadata. If Sales wants a credit + quota change, treat as two actions: finance issues credit, product/eng approves quota delta.

Leo (Sales): Noted. For enterprise deals we should include quota guarantees in the contract (SOW) not in the promo credit terms. Otherwise customers expect both and get confused.

Maya (PM): Customers keep asking for a programmatic way to request temporary quota bumps from CI pipelines. Is there a safe API for that?

DevOpsBot: Admin endpoint exists but gated: POST /admin/v1/temp_quota_request {
  "account_id": "<id>",
  "requested_additional_qps": "<int>",
  "duration_seconds": "<int>",
  "reason": "<string>"
}  Requires service token + approval workflow. Auto-reject if risk score > 70.

Samir (VP Product): We won't allow blind CI-driven quota increases without a human in the loop. Approval needs account lead + CS or Sales ok. We'll publish the API but it will return a request ID and require explicit approval.

Riley (Support): Operationally, when a launch ticket comes in include: expected start/end times, expected peak RPS, auth token sample, and traffic pattern. Use the console "Launch support" form — it routes to on-call and Sales/CS. Template: https://console.redwood.example.com/launch-support

Ava (CEO): Who owns the customer-facing playbook? We need something short that product, sales, and solutions can use.

Maya (PM): I'll own a one-pager and add a "Launch Support" checklist into the console. Items: preflight (test workload), request window, mitigation plan, fallbacks (lower-quality model, throttled endpoints), contact list. Draft by EOD Friday.

Jamie (Finance): Also add a note about invoicing when we do pro-rated reserved capacity or one-off invoice credits for launch overages. Keep the billing path separate from temporary quota approvals.

Leo (Sales): Can we add a toggle in the console to request an invoice credit instead of platform credit? Clients ask for that often.
